name: QU-BD One/TwoUp Extruder V11 with video

captions.detailed: This 3D model is a custom replacement extruder assembly for a 3D printer, featuring integrated cooling ducts. The assembly includes a main rectangular mounting block with screw holes for gantry attachment, a pivotable lever arm, and a long cylindrical hot-end barrel. Dual angled, octagonal cooling vents extend from the main body, directing airflow precisely toward the nozzle area.
captions.instruction: Design a parametric 3D printer extruder body and lever assembly with integrated dual cooling vents. The script should allow adjustments for the motor dimensions, spring hole size, bearing clearance, and vent angles to fit custom printer setups.
captions.factory: The design is constructed using a main body box via cube primitives, with cylindrical subtractions for the motor shaft, bearing hub, and mounting screws. The cooling vents are modeled using octagonal cylinders (using $fn=8) that are hollowed out by subtracting smaller cylinders. Boolean difference operations are used to route the hot-end opening and the dual vent paths, while translate and rotate transforms position the lever arm and fan mounting plate relative to the main extruder body.
